scenario: A ferry operator logs passenger counts only for sailings with more than 200 passengers. The planner wants the average load across all sailings.

data.description: Only sailings above 200 passengers are observed. Passenger count is Normal with known sigma 50.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean passenger count mu across all sailings and (b) the fraction of sailings represented in the log.
naive_answer: Average load is about 226 passengers because that is the log mean.
naive_trap: Low-occupancy sailings are missing from the log.
reasoning_trace: Solve 226.26 = mu + 50*lambda((200-mu)/50). The solution is mu≈150 and logged fraction sf(1.0).
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(200-mu)/50; return mu+50*norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-226.26
mu=brentq(eq,-200,199.99)
frac=norm.sf((200-mu)/50)
assert abs(mu-150)<3 and abs(frac-0.1587)<0.005
